open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-001 Required test binding
open_points.text: “PLAT-REG-001: a focused test at `validate_project_reference` showing the invariant holds” is bound to a check that replaces `validate_project_reference` with a stub and therefore never tests the named gateway function or whether the portal can generate project identities.
open_points.question: What check exercises the real `validate_project_reference` boundary and demonstrates that an unknown portal-supplied UUID is refused without change?
options: Bind a check that calls the real gateway function
Change the Required test to describe only the authorization guard behavior actually checked
open_points.default_guess: Require a real focused gateway check in addition to the guard check.

witness.initial: The Registry does not know project P, and an administrator has a valid active session.
events: The administrator requests a read of P.
Implementation X calls a correct real `validate_project_reference`; implementation Y has a real gateway that fabricates an active validation result for P.
The bound check runs and substitutes its own rejecting validation stub in both implementations.
outcomes: Both implementations pass the bound check, while X refuses P with `ScopedNotFoundError`.
Both implementations pass the bound check, while Y authorizes access to the fabricated project P.
witness.observer: The administrator and any verification reviewer relying on PLAT-REG-001.

open_points.subject: PLAT-REG-001 witness principal coverage
open_points.text: “a project id the Registry does not know is refused with `ScopedNotFoundError` for every principal” is bound to a check whose unknown-project case invokes only `authorize_staff_project_read` with an administrator.
open_points.question: Which checks demonstrate the stated unknown-project refusal for viewer, operator, administrator, granted-project producer, and all-projects producer paths?
options: Add unknown-project cases for every principal path named by the witness
Narrow the witness to the administrator path actually asserted
open_points.default_guess: Add explicit cases for every principal path.

witness.initial: Project P is unknown to Registry; an active viewer has a stale grant to P, an operator has a stale assignment, and an all-projects producer is active.
events: Each principal requests its permitted read or import operation for P.
Implementation X applies Registry nonexistence to every principal; implementation Y rejects the tested administrator but lets one untested principal path proceed.
The supplied bound check runs only its administrator unknown-project case.
outcomes: X refuses every request with the scoped not-found result.
Y passes the supplied check but authorizes the untested viewer, operator, or producer request.
witness.observer: The affected principal and the verification reviewer.

open_points.subject: INV-026 Required test binding
open_points.text: “INV-026: a focused test at `import_snapshot` showing the invariant holds; a violating input is refused and changes nothing” is bound to a derived-view check that neither calls `import_snapshot` nor supplies a violating import.
open_points.question: What test at `import_snapshot` proves that planned values cannot be derived from actual expenses and that mutable producer state cannot change an existing portal budget?
options: Bind an import test with a violating publication and unchanged-budget assertions
Rewrite the Required test and invariant scope to only cover the budget-view projection currently checked
open_points.default_guess: Add the focused import test required by the existing invariant.

witness.initial: A project has a plan of 500.00 and confirmed expenses, and already has an accepted snapshot.
events: The producer imports another publication or repeats mutable source data.
Implementation X leaves existing planned values unchanged; implementation Y rewrites planned values from current expenses or mutable producer state.
The bound derived-view check runs only against its independently seeded plans and allocations.
outcomes: X preserves the portal budget and passes the bound check.
Y also passes the bound check, but a later viewer read observes rewritten planned values.
witness.observer: The viewer and the operator reviewing the budget.

open_points.subject: INV-027 Required test binding
open_points.text: “budget totals and all financial aggregates are derived at read time, never stored as editable values” and “a violating input is refused and changes nothing” are bound to a check that verifies one projection result but does not inspect or challenge stored editable totals, nor exercise any refusal.
open_points.question: What observable test proves totals are not persisted as editable state, and what constitutes the violating input that `build_budget_view` must refuse without change?
options: Add a persistence/schema and stale-cache test proving totals come only from owning records
Define a concrete invalid stored state and its required read behavior
Remove the refusal wording if this invariant has no refusing input
open_points.default_guess: Test that changing only owning plans or allocations changes the view and that no persisted aggregate can override the recomputation.

witness.initial: Plans and allocations imply a material total of 700.00, while an implementation also stores an editable cached total of 700.00.
events: An operator changes a plan so the owning records now imply 800.00.
Implementation X recomputes from the plans; implementation Y reads the stale stored total.
The supplied check is run only on the original consistent seed.
outcomes: Y passes the supplied check but later reports the stale 700.00.
witness.observer: Staff and viewers reading the budget.

open_points.subject: INV-033 Required test binding
open_points.text: “a replacement persists exactly the operator's amounts … and one whose sum differs from the total is refused without any write instead of being spread” is bound to `client_portal_expense_management_uow_check.py`, whose supplied content contains no such assertions and only delegates to `run_management_checks` in an unprovided support module.
open_points.question: Where is the bound evidence that asserts the exact 150.00/50.00 persistence and the no-write refusal for a mismatched sum?
options: Bind the support check containing those assertions and provide its content for resolution
Put the assertions directly in the named focused check
Narrow the witness to assertions visible in the bound evidence
open_points.default_guess: Bind and expose the support check that contains the exact-value and rollback assertions.

witness.initial: An expense totals 200.00 and currently has another allocation set.
events: An operator requests replacement with 150.00 to a section and 50.00 to other expenses, then requests an invalid 150.00 and 40.00 replacement.
Implementation X persists the first values exactly and refuses the second without writes; implementation Y redistributes or normalizes one of the requests.
A reviewer examines only the supplied bound file, which contains no value or rollback assertion.
outcomes: The reviewer can verify neither whether X is required by the executable check nor whether it is enforced.
The same visible binding is compatible with Y unless the unavailable delegated check happens to distinguish it.
witness.observer: The verification reviewer and, if Y is accepted, the operator reading the allocations.

open_points.subject: INV-050 Required test binding
open_points.text: “the views built from the same seeded records answer the exact expected totals and the declared orderings, identity ties included, for staff and viewer alike” is bound to a check that asserts exact budget totals for one direct staff-context budget read, checks several other derived values only for non-nullness, and checks the viewer overview only for its photo set.
open_points.question: Which assertions establish every derived value, deterministic repetition for the same inputs, and equal derived answers for staff and viewer rather than only photo visibility?
options: Add exact assertions for every derived value and repeat the reads for both actor kinds
Narrow INV-050 and its witness to the values and actor paths actually asserted
open_points.default_guess: Add repeated exact-value assertions for all derived components under both staff and viewer contexts.

witness.initial: The same plans, allocations, progress, payments, and photos are visible to an authorized staff member and viewer.
events: Staff reads the overview, then the viewer reads it twice.

Implementation X computes the same exact financial and progress values every time; implementation Y returns correct staff values but a wrong or varying viewer progress percentage or work balance while preserving the expected viewer photo set.
The supplied check asserts staff component values selectively and only the viewer photo set.
outcomes: Y can satisfy the supplied assertions while viewers observe different or nondeterministic derived values.
witness.observer: The viewer and the verification reviewer.
